title.en: Banking in India: Scheduled Commercial Banks
title.hi: Banking in India: Scheduled Commercial Banks

definition.en: Scheduled Commercial Banks are those banks which are included in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, and are eligible for loans from the RBI.
definition.hi: Scheduled Commercial Banks are those banks which are included in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, and are eligible for loans from the RBI.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the structure of Scheduled Commercial Banks is essential for GS-3 Economy, as they form the backbone of the Indian financial system. Questions frequently appear regarding their regulatory framework, role in credit creation, and their interaction with RBI monetary policy.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding the structure of Scheduled Commercial Banks is essential for GS-3 Economy, as they form the backbone of the Indian financial system. Questions frequently appear regarding their regulatory framework, role in credit creation, and their interaction with RBI monetary policy.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the criteria for inclusion in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of commercial banks in the Indian economy and financial inclusion.
